title: From Enter to the page
instruction: Put in order what happens from pressing Enter to the finished page.
steps: You type the address and press Enter
DNS translates the name into the IP address of the server
The browser sends the server a request for the page
The browser asks for CSS, scripts and pictures
debrief: Every page is an exchange of requests and responses. First the name to an address, then the HTML, then everything the HTML points to.
why: Everything starts with you: the address is a name, not a number.
Without the IP address the request would not know where to go.
Only now does it know where to send the request.
The response to the first request is the skeleton of the page.
Only in the HTML does the browser find out which other files the page needs.
From all the files that arrived, it puts together the picture you see.
